qa_pairs.question: How did the composition of the Licensing Authority for a Customs Agent License change regarding the role of a Deputy Commissioner according to the amendments?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the initial rules [0, 1], the Licensing Authority for a Customs Agent License was composed of an Additional Commissioner and a Deputy Commissioner (or a Joint Commissioner and Assistant Commissioner if no Additional Commissioner was present). The subsequent amendment [2] modified this to allow for a more flexible structure where the Licensing Authority is composed of an Additional Commissioner or Joint Commissioner alongside a Deputy Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner.
